title: Rename a constant across 5 Python files using search
description: A Python codebase uses MAX_RETRIES = 3 scattered across 5 files. Rename it to MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS everywhere. Agent must use search_text to find all occurrences, then apply edits. Tests verify the rename.

files.config.py:
# Global retry configuration
MAX_RETRIES = 3
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30
BASE_URL = 'http://api.example.com'
files.test_retry.py:
import pytest
from config import MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
from http_client import get
from job_runner import run_job
from worker import Worker


def test_config_constant():
    assert MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS == 3


def test_http_default_retries():
    """get() uses MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS as default."""
    import inspect
    sig = inspect.signature(get)
    assert sig.parameters['retries'].default == MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS


def test_worker_default_retries():
    w = Worker()
    assert w.max_retries == MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
